scope: Typed native-lp64 target record (pointer/count/view widths and alignments, every scalar from the checker's type table, calling convention c) and exact authored declaration spans in coax deps --declarations and --modules. Other layout targets refuse with E0612; generated declarations carry their #import_proto origin instead of a span.

parser.change: each top-level item records end = last token offset + raw_count before linking

checker.change: CK_Target record and CK_target(name): native-lp64 supported, every other name unsupported with a reason; tied to CK_builtin's string layout

cases: native-lp64 pointer, count, view and 11 scalar sizes/alignments equal an independent C11 sizeof/alignof oracle; struct layout under both #if profiles uses the same count width
wasm32, metal, spirv and native-ilp32 refuse layout, deps --declarations and deps --modules with E0612 and print no report
spans select exactly the authored bytes (struct with #if form, enum with trailing comment, constant, procedure) across two loaded units; lines match; the release profile reports the same span
moving declarations keeps IDs, bytes and span sha256 while start offsets move; an edit changes only that declaration's hash
#import_proto declarations report span null and origin {directive, unit, line}

limits: Revisions stay module-scoped; spans and the target record are separate from nominal IDs. Schema-1 CPU reflection (type_info, field_info) is not Wasm or GPU metadata. No other layout target is qualified.
